'''July 2001 Clarks Summit tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Clarks Summit on 8 July 2001. It is known from Kelly Krieble's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2611">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-10-clarks-summit-7-8-01d2611/ clarks-summit-7-8-01], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 10 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-10-clarks-summit-7-8-01d2611/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Clarks Summit
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
